title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: refuse the per-item publish and rollback naming no package over a disabled holder's package-less row
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwictsQHxYdcVwUTSp

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao6zarfSoHXrjcTjK3VZ3Pav)_
Fixes #37608

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches a per-item publish or rollback naming no package over a name only disabled packages hold; the refusal's own sentence names the fix

## 维护者速读

- 管理员停用一个包之后，在没指明包的情况下对这个包名下的“无包定制”做单项发布或回滚，以前会悄悄写进被隐藏的那一行，现在会被拒绝，并提示先启用这个包。
- 这是“停用就该全部消失”那次裁决的收尾：保存、草稿、删除、丢弃草稿四个入口已经拦住，这次补上发布和回滚这最后两个入口。
- 碰到的只有对停用包名下的定制做发布或回滚的管理员；先启用包再操作即可，启用后看到的定制和停用前一字不差；本改动可整体撤回。
- 无

## What changes

ADR-0150 D3 (its 2026-11-26 note, ruled on topic #36229: 「我觉得停用就该全部消失」): a package-less row stored at a name a package holds is that package's customization, hidden with it while it is disabled. The save, the draft save, the delete and the draft discard naming no package already refuse there. Two doors did not ask that judgment and still wrote the hidden row:

- **Per-item publish** (`promoteDraftForPublish`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`): where no package is named and the promotion reads the package-unbound draft or writes the package-unbound active row (a draft at the address, `key` or `into` null), and a package-unbound row or draft is stored, the door now asks `packagelessHolderRefusal` over the active rows and the drafts, as the draft save does. Answered with the door's other address refusals, after the `_lock` gate. A promotion of a package's own draft into its own row, and a publish with no draft (`404 NO_DRAFT`), are not asked (L1 R1, PR comment 7210673235).
- **Per-item rollback** (`rollbackMetaItemUnaudited`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts`): where no package is named and the restore writes the package-unbound row, and such a row is stored, the door asks the same judgment, after the ADR-0146 D11 close.

Both ask the **disabled-holders judgment only** (new `arms: 'disabled-holders'` parameter on `packagelessHolderRefusal`; default `'all'` keeps every existing caller byte-identical). Over a name only disabled packages hold, both answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with #37584's sentence (`disabledHoldersCustomizationRefusal`, verb `publish` / `rollback`: "Enable the package that holds TYPE 'NAME' first, then send this publish again …"), naming no package, and write nothing. Re-enabled, the read naming no package serves the original row byte-identical, and the same publish or rollback answers as before.

The verb type is widened to `DisabledHoldersWriteVerb = 'save' | 'delete' | 'publish' | 'rollback'` on the two refusal builders and the judgment.

Also in this PR:
- **Migration entry** `disabled-holder-package-less-row-bare-write-refused` (spec, still pending release) names the publish and rollback doors in its surface, replacement, reason and acceptance criteria; its header comment is reworded (review nit N10).
- **New changeset** `.changeset/37608-disabled-holder-publish-rollback-refused.md` (`minor` metadata-protocol and spec, BREAKING, ADR-0087 `not-required (already-registered …)`: the entry above already exists on the merge base).
- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION** of the pending note `.changeset/37499-disabled-holder-unbound-row-bare-write-refused.md` (review nit N11). Corrected sentence: "there only the draft discard moves: over a stored package-less draft from `200` to the `409` above, and over a stored package-less row with no draft from the `409` with the `?package=` sentence to the same `409` with the enable sentence." It read "there only the draft discard moves, from `200` to the `409` above.", which was false for the stored-row, no-draft cell. `check-empty-changeset` is red on this file by design; the dispatching seat's record confirms it.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts`, the served-stack file #37584 added, gains one `describe` with three pins in the cell the D11 close leaves open (`fr-FR`, a member the package never ships):

- publish, a package-less draft beside the stored package-less row;
- publish, a package-less draft with no row stored;
- rollback of the package-less row to its first version;
- CONTROL (L1 R1): publish of the package's own draft beside the stored package-less row: promoted into the package's row as on `main`, the package-less row byte-identical;
- CONTROL: publish with no draft beside the stored package-less row: `404 NO_DRAFT` as on `main`, nothing written.

The three refusal pins assert `status` + `code` (409 / `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`), the message's first words (the remedy a reader acts on), that no package is named, every stored row of the name (active and draft) byte-identical, then re-enables and asserts the row served as it was and the same write landing.

<details><summary>Reach on main, fix, and one ablation per door</summary>

- **Reach, `main` 56c9cae6** (pins committed first as 3c3b8f0cc, run against main's `metadata-protocol` dist): `Tests 3 failed | 5 passed (8)`; each of the three answered no refusal (`expected [ undefined, undefined ] to deeply equal [ 409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT' ]`): the publish promoted the draft and the rollback rewrote the row, both hidden by the disabled package.
- **Fix** (metadata-protocol rebuilt, the new code confirmed in `dist/index.js`): `Tests 8 passed (8)` at 245dbd039; after R1, `Tests 10 passed (10)` at 4793a980f.
- **Ablation, publish door** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the `if (active.unbound || address.drafts.unbound)` guard, rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 2 built files): `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)`, exactly the two publish pins. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, marker absent from all 24 built files.
- **Ablation, rollback door** (same tool on the rollback's `if (active.unbound)` guard): `Tests 1 failed | 7 passed (8)`, exactly the rollback pin. Restored the same way.
- **After R1, at 4793a980f, three legs on the 10 pins**, each mutated, rebuilt, marker proved in `dist/`, then restored (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, marker absent): the R1 address condition dropped (the 245dbd039 shape): `2 failed | 8 passed`, exactly the two controls (so the PKG-own-draft cell answers `409` there, as L1 measured); the publish guard off (main's publish): `2 failed | 8 passed`, exactly the two publish refusal pins, the two controls green (they pin `main`'s answer); the rollback guard off: `1 failed | 9 passed`, the rollback pin.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Order against the D11 close is unchanged.** Where ADR-0146 D11 applies (one read-only code package ships the item, with a pair), the publish and the rollback still answer the close's `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` first, with the package enabled or disabled. Whether the enable remedy should answer first over an every-holder-disabled base is a change to a shipped answer and goes through the seat's decision route (card comment 7196921497); not taken here.
- **Bounded to the customization cell.** The publish asks only where it reads the package-unbound draft or writes the package-unbound row, and the rollback only where it restores the package-unbound row, each with a package-unbound row or draft stored. Not moved: a publish of a package's own draft into its own row (beside a package-less row or not), a publish with no draft (`404 NO_DRAFT`), a rollback with no package-less row stored, and the two-enabled-holders refusal (the doors keep their own two-holder refusals, `packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal` and `historySlotOf`). Each would move a shipped answer (`404 NO_DRAFT` or a write into a package-bound row) beyond the ruled cell.
- **ADR-0150 D3 note not edited.** Its bullet "Not judged yet: the per-item publish and the per-item rollback … Card #37608 carries both doors. Until it lands …" goes stale once this merges, and N11's ADR half ("newly refuses the draft discard in every cell") is not tightened. Both live in `docs/adr/**` (Tier H); kept out so this PR stays off a governed surface. Carrier: #37245 (ADR revisions weekly card; the seat appends the row after merge)
- `reassignOrphanedMetadata` lead (card comment 7196921497, third bullet): not measured here. Carrier: the seat.
- N12 (the D11 decision card should quote the `403` sentence in full) is for the seat's decision card, not this diff.
- REST: `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish` and `/rollback` forward the request with no `packageId` key when `?package=` is absent (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`), so the in-process pins measure the same door. No REST-level pin added.

## Verification

Read first (by risk):
1. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`, the new block at the end of the `else` arm in `promoteDraftForPublish` (the address branch naming no package).

3. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts`, `packagelessHolderRefusal`'s new `arms` parameter.
